name: Yorùbá Ifẹ̀ creation traditions (Obàtálá / Odùduwà)
source_label: Multiple Yorùbá oral traditions centered on Ilé-Ifẹ̀

earliest_archaeological_evidence.note: Archaeology dates Ilé-Ifẹ̀'s urban and artistic development, but those dates do not by themselves date this specific creation narrative.

earliest_written_attestation.note: This batch verifies the narrative through modern museum/ethnographic scholarship and does not claim an earliest written version until a specific early witness is independently pinned down.

tradition_internal_claim.note: Multiple Yorùbá origin traditions identify Ilé-Ifẹ̀ as the place where land, human life, and/or civilization begin; versions differ over the roles and priority of Obàtálá and Odùduwà.

estimated_oral_origin.method: The tradition is oral and variant. The exact date of the Obàtálá/Odùduwà narrative cannot be recovered from the sources used here.

dating.dating_summary: The Ifẹ̀ creation tradition is securely documented as a living Yorùbá oral tradition with multiple versions, while its composition and oral-origin dates remain genuinely unknown; archaeological dates for Ilé-Ifẹ̀ are not used as dates for the story.

notes: Do not collapse competing Obàtálá/Odùduwà versions into one canonical Yorùbá account. The existing Ifá/Òrìṣà tradition entity separately records the broader tradition's documentary history.
